body:
## Pull request overview

Unifies the codebase around a single authoritative data driver contract (`IDataDriver` in `@objectstack/spec/contracts`) by deprecating `DriverInterface` as an alias and aligning driver implementations/tests/docs to the expanded contract.

**Changes:**
- Deprecates `DriverInterface` and re-exports the unified contract from core/spec for backward-compatible imports.
- Updates `driver-sql` and `driver-memory` to implement `IDataDriver` (methods + `supports` capability descriptor) and aligns return types (`updateMany`/`deleteMany` → `number`, `delete` → `boolean`).
- Updates tests/docs/changelog to reflect the unified contract and updated method shapes.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts | Replaces the old `DriverInterface` interface with a deprecated alias to `IDataDriver`. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.test.ts | Updates contract tests to validate `DriverInterface` as an alias of `IDataDriver` and exercises more of the unified surface. |
| packages/spec/llms.txt | Documentation updates to position `IDataDriver` as the authoritative driver contract. |
| packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts | Switches to `IDataDriver`, adds missing methods/capabilities, and aligns return types. |
| packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-advanced.test.ts | Updates assertions for the new `updateMany`/`deleteMany` return types. |
| packages/plugins/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts | Switches to `IDataDriver` and expands `supports` to the full capability set; aligns return types. |
| packages/objectql/src/engine.ts | Tightens typings for driver `create`/`update` calls to use `Record<string, unknown>`. |
| packages/objectql/src/engine.test.ts | Updates test typing to `IDataDriver` (but still uses legacy mock shape/casts). |
| packages/core/src/index.ts | Re-exports `IDataDriver` alongside deprecated `DriverInterface`. |
| packages/core/src/contracts/data-engine.ts | Removes the duplicate core driver contract and re-exports the spec contract type. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the unified contract and the breaking return-type changes. |
</details>

The engine test mocks are still using a `capabilities` property and casting `as unknown as IDataDriver`, which bypasses the unified contract this PR is trying to enforce. Update these mocks to provide the required `supports` field (and any required methods you rely on) and avoid the double-cast so the test suite actually catches interface drift.

Same issue for the second driver mock: it uses `capabilities` and relies on `as unknown as IDataDriver`, so the test won’t detect missing required `IDataDriver` members like `supports`, `checkHealth`, etc. Prefer a properly shaped mock (or a minimal factory) that conforms to `IDataDriver` without unsafe casts.
